source_policy.scope: Original CB dated S1/S2 populations and original CC/CX archived intraday observations only.
source_policy.authentication: Exact compressed and decoded pins, exclusive new per-run byte index, independent complete original-byte and every-coordinate audit. Preserve all prior caches and artifacts.
source_policy.availability: Assumed minute end plus two minutes, distinct from retrieved_at. Historical receipt, cross-session price basis and physical volume units remain unverified.
source_policy.raw_access_gate: Same-release reviewed normal merge, complete invented qualification and separate original receipt audit, then durable actual1 STARTED before original bytes.

measurement.grid: Every five-minute E>=30 at E+2 strictly before regular close, including non-event and unknown frames.
measurement.prefix: Opening to decision, with first-attempt availability checked at original decision deadlines; no late repair of earlier unknown state.
measurement.anchor: Earliest confirmed high left<center>=right with three pre-peak bars. R is their median individual range. R>0, peak minus session first open>=2R. Freeze anchor at confirmation, earliest E32.
measurement.A: First positive-depth pullback <=1/2 advance, <=6 bars after peak, <=1 observed retest; resumption separately records a later close above preceding high.
measurement.B: Advance>=3R and >=2 observed retests with current bar overlapping the frozen band.
measurement.retests: A complete bar wholly below band arms a subsequent overlapping bar. Adjacent touching bars are one episode; no intrabar order inference.
measurement.invalidation: First completed close at or below initial session open permanently invalidates this anchor; no replacement anchor selected later.
measurement.unknowns: Missing or late required prefix is unknown, observed no-anchor/zero-reference-range unclassified, other observed contexts retained. Volume missingness never erases price-only context.
measurement.cases: First two distinct sorted original coordinates per classification and their earliest class frame. Full causal prefixes retained; outcome-blind illustrations, not representative performance.

verification: Separate raw decoders and independent prefix/window/anchor/context reconstruction for every original coordinate and all frame hashes, exact case roster and chart prefixes, canonical summary and full EOF. Separate saved artifact/receipt audit before a following unit.

qualification.preserved_prior_attempt: qualification-v1 completed invented computation but its independent receipt audit rejected a retained EH marker. Preserve every v1 path and receipt; v1 cannot qualify this release. EI actual1 remains unspent.
qualification.release: Distinct final source and research integrity reviews, all four required CI and normal merge.
qualification.whole_path: Exact source/runtime, full invented geometry and causal context/missingness cases, three ordinary measured roles, journal, original output and terminal receipts.
qualification.receipt_audit: Separate audit of original same-release invented receipts before actual1.

claim_limit: Causal support and context census only. Repeated frames are not independent events, signals or trades. Context classification is not an entry instruction, path forecast or return. No model fit, P&L, confirmation or promotion.
